all_errors_at_once.statement: An invoice with several defects (missing customer name, bad quantity, negative price, bad tax rate, bad discount) yields every error in one validation, each naming its field path.
must_include: all validation errors reported at once

rounding_half_up.statement: Line totals, discount and tax round half-up to cents using Decimal (e.g. 3 x 0.125 = 0.38, tax on 10.05 at 5% = 0.50); subtotal - discount + tax equals the grand total.

output_formats.statement: The default output is a formatted text invoice listing items, subtotal, discount, tax and total; --format json emits parseable JSON with the same amounts as strings.

stdlib_single_file.statement: invoice_gen.py imports only standard-library modules and the tests run against that single file.

bad_input_exit_codes.statement: A missing file or non-JSON content exits 2; a structurally invalid invoice exits 1 with all errors on stderr; a valid one exits 0.
